target: acceptances 1+3 — `git diff --numstat` prints `-` for binary files. Summing that as 0 reports 'no diff' for a real, non-empty one: the exact null-vs-zero collapse this spec forbids. Only countable rows count; if none are countable the answer is null.
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic; printf "%s" '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; git init -q .; git config user.email a@b; git config user.name a; printf "x\n" > a.txt; git add -A; git commit -qm base; b=$(git rev-parse HEAD); printf "\000\001\002\003\004\005" > bin.dat; git add -A; git commit -qm bin; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" diff-size --base "$b" --head HEAD </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; cat .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl | tail -1
